rows.text: an 8x8 two-pass byte filter: it first copies 9 rows of 16 bytes from argument 1 (rows dword argument 2 apart, sign-extended) into an aligned stack block; with H = the 16 bytes at `030011F0` + 16*argument 3 and V = those at `030011F0` + 16*argument 4, each result byte is (x0*f0 + x1*f1 + 64) >> 7, computed by `pmaddubsw` over interleaved byte pairs, the 64s from `03001060`, an arithmetic shift and packing with unsigned saturation. It writes 8 rows of 8 bytes to argument 5, rows dword argument 6 apart (sign-extended): when argument 3 is 0, vertically with V over consecutive stack rows (unrolled); else when argument 4 is 0, horizontally with H over each stack row and the same row one byte on (four rows per iteration); otherwise each stack row from the first is filtered horizontally to bytes h and each output row is the pair (h_previous, h) filtered with V; it saves and restores `xmm6`/`xmm7` and the realigned stack
